quotes.name: Sacrifice
quotes.flavor: Cultists eagerly undergo the Rite of the Threshold, allowing Valgavoth to feed on their fear and bind them to the essence of the House.

quotes.name: Tavern Ruffian // Tavern Smasher
quotes.flavor: With every arm in sight broken, she turned her attention to the furniture.

quotes.name: Forced Landing
quotes.flavor: The druid knew only one spell, a charm to encourage rapid plant growth. When airborne Eternals invaded her arboretum, she had to get creative.

quotes.name: Kozilek's Pathfinder
quotes.flavor:
"We didn't know where it came from or where it was going. All we knew was that we did not matter."
—Akiri, kor line-slinger

quotes.name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
quotes.flavor: "The greatest honor is to feed Atarka."

quotes.name: Daybreak Combatants
quotes.flavor: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

quotes.name: Eladamri's Vineyard
quotes.flavor: Good company is sweeter than any summer wine.

quotes.name: Invigorated Rampage
quotes.flavor: Gremlins can change from pest to problem to plague in the span of a moment.

quotes.name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
quotes.flavor:
"She binds them to do naught but worship her. It is no salvation she grants, but servitude."
—Geist of Saint Thalia

quotes.name: Druid of the Cowl
quotes.flavor: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Chaos renegades always seek to deface and destroy effigies of Imperial piety, replacing them with blasphemous symbols of the Ruinous Powers.

quotes.name: Benthic Explorers
quotes.flavor: Distant Atlantis charged these Explorers with the task of venturing into unknown waters to track the despised Viscerids.

quotes.name: Ulvenwald Oddity // Ulvenwald Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"We've learned enough! I say we run."
—Alena, Kessig trapper

quotes.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: Her centuries-long search is ended.

quotes.name: Uproot
quotes.flavor:
"We arrived at the battlefield too late. *Again*. Another error on your part, and you will have to answer to me personally."
—General Takeno, letter to the imperial mapmaker

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

quotes.name: Shefet Archfiend
quotes.flavor: It yields only to the gods themselves.

quotes.name: Marrow-Gnawer
quotes.flavor: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

quotes.name: Moon-Boy, Dino Rider
quotes.flavor: "To have such a brother is to be filled with pride!"

quotes.name: Moonsilver Key
quotes.flavor: To restore the day-night balance, the Celestus mechanism's Sungold Lock must be reunited with its long-lost key.

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: It is rumored that wild breeds of the species— including those which have retained the capacity for flight—still thrive throughout forests nestled in the vastly unexplored valleys of Abalathia's Spine.

quotes.name: Kazandu Nectarpot
quotes.flavor:
"The scythe-like forelegs are crucial for its survival, because it tastes really good and every inhabitant of Murasa knows it."
—Arhana, Kazandu trapfinder

quotes.name: Grove of the Burnwillows
quotes.flavor: Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.

quotes.name: Kin-Tree Invocation
quotes.flavor: The passing years add new rings to the tree's trunk, bolstering the spirits that dwell within.

quotes.name: Etched Champion
quotes.flavor: Its predecessors were etched with the wisdom of ancients; its own etchings bear warnings of a future fraught with war.

quotes.name: Exultant Cultist
quotes.flavor: Amid the gibbering chorus that rose from the drownyard temple, Jace recognized a single word: "Emrakul."

quotes.name: Crypt Incursion
quotes.flavor: Suddenly a song began: a cold murmur, rising and falling, grim, cold, heartless and miserable. The night was railing against the morning of which it was bereaved, and the cold was cursing the warmth for which it hungered.

quotes.name: Galvanic Discharge
quotes.flavor:
"Remember, if you find a rock making crackly noises, just put it back. Carefully."
—Bo, Great Desert prospector

quotes.name: Lovestruck Beast // Heart's Desire
quotes.flavor: His mind chose solitude, but his heart disagreed.

quotes.name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
quotes.flavor:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

quotes.name: Razor Rings
quotes.flavor:
"There's someone in there! He's bending the vines!"
—Sokka

quotes.name: Awakening Zone
quotes.flavor: The ground erupted in time with the hedron's thrum, a dirge of the last days.

quotes.name: Bounty of Might
quotes.flavor:
"I am the very soul of battle, but even I would never advise open war with the Conclave."
—Aurelia

quotes.name: Mystic Skyfish
quotes.flavor: The problem wasn't that fish had learned how to fly. It was that sharks had adapted to follow them.

quotes.name: Gen, Confider of Ages
quotes.flavor: Prize Card for the Unknown event at Gen Con, August 3rd, 2023.

quotes.name: Into the Roil
quotes.flavor: "Roil tide! Roil tide! Tie yourselves down!"

quotes.name: Squeaking Pie Sneak
quotes.flavor:
"Why do our pies squeak? It's all the faeries, mice, and prickly-hogs we stuff inside."
—Borb of the Squeaking Pie warren

quotes.name: Bedrock Tortoise
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Many temples have strong foundations. Few are also wise.

quotes.name: Venus, Torn Between Worlds
quotes.flavor: Built from scraps. Defined by self.

quotes.name: Symbiote Spawn
quotes.flavor: The Life Foundation captured Venom and extracted seeds for newborn symbiotes. Symbiotes they could not control.

quotes.name: Death's-Head Buzzard
quotes.flavor: Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.

quotes.name: Thornhide Wolves
quotes.flavor:
"Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out. That was a mistake for which we almost paid dearly."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Permeating Mass
quotes.flavor: Woodland geists concluded that Emrakul would be unable to warp the denizens of the forest if the geists got there first.

quotes.name: Rage Weaver
quotes.flavor: "Let my passion spur your victory."

quotes.name: Diligent Zookeeper
quotes.flavor: "I wish I could get her a big, open prairie like she likes. I'd let her hop her way to happiness."

quotes.name: Soured Springs
quotes.flavor:
"Groundwater's tainted here. Best push on before our canteens run out."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Might of Oaks
quotes.flavor: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

quotes.name: Ensoul Artifact
quotes.flavor: Too often, some self-described genius comes up with a "labor-saving device" that ends up creating far more work.

quotes.name: Gone Missing
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes it's best for the lost to stay lost."
—Herzag, mayor of Havengul

quotes.name: Presence of Gond
quotes.flavor: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

quotes.name: Eliminate
quotes.flavor:
「人を消すのにほとんどエネルギーはいらない。稀で宇宙がその存在を全く気にしてないかのようにな。」
——エクスタス・ナー

quotes.name: Sun-Blessed Peak
quotes.flavor: The sacred site of firebending's first spark.

quotes.name: Deeproot Waters
quotes.flavor: A visit to the Deeproot Tree and its ancient spring replenishes a merfolk's connection to nature.

quotes.name: Towering-Wave Mystic
quotes.flavor: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

quotes.name: Butcher's Cleaver
quotes.flavor: Outside the safety of Thraben, there is little distinction between tool and weapon.

quotes.name: Hour of Eternity
quotes.flavor: To serve as an eternal is the afterlife granted to the worthy.

quotes.name: Tukatongue Thallid
quotes.flavor: Jund's thallids tried to disguise their deliciousness by covering themselves in spines harvested from the tukatongue tree.

quotes.name: Exhaustion
quotes.flavor: Tired doesn't even begin to cover it.

quotes.name: Recover
quotes.flavor:
"No more fear of death's oblivion—is this not the greatest treasure of all?"
—Gurezan, Legion resurrectionist

quotes.name: Sagittars' Volley
quotes.flavor:
"My bowstring hums in tune with the song of the Worldsoul."
—Alcarus, Selesnya sagittar

quotes.name: Sower of Temptation
quotes.flavor: One glamer leads him far from home. The next washes away his memory that home was ever anywhere but at her side.

quotes.name: Unearth
quotes.flavor: No matter how deep you bury it, some evil refuses to stay dead.

quotes.name: Throne of the High City
quotes.flavor: The high throne was empty. At the foot of its dais, upon the lowest step which was broad and deep, there was a stone chair, black and unadorned, for the Steward of Gondor.

quotes.name: Reanimate
quotes.flavor:
"Death is a small price to pay for immortality."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Treasure Cruise
quotes.flavor: Countless delights drift on the surface while dark schemes run below.

quotes.name: Oviya Pashiri, Sage Lifecrafter
quotes.flavor: "Inspiration is reciprocal: we all have a responsibility to each other to create."

quotes.name: Farbog Boneflinger
quotes.flavor:
"Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!"
—Gisa, to Geralf

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Ionize
quotes.flavor: Backfire Bummer! Sizzling Slinger Singes Slickshot

quotes.name: Helping Hand
quotes.flavor:
「優しさとは一種の争いであり、決して失ってはいけないものである。」
――「戦癒しの論文」

quotes.name: Sculpted Sunburst
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: A searing light that spares only the chosen.

quotes.name: Ashiok's Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Every nightmare is a caged bird that yearns to be set free."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

quotes.name: Wild Hunger
quotes.flavor: Otto the Hunter was filled with many grand ambitions. The snake was filled only with Otto.

quotes.name: Esquire of the King
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Where now the horse and the rider?
Where is the horn that was blowing?
Where is the helm and the hauberk,
and the bright hair flowing?"
—Lament for the Rohirrim

quotes.name: Titanic Bulvox
quotes.flavor: With natural laws abandoned, excess thrives.

quotes.name: Bone Sabres
quotes.flavor: Charged with psychic energy, the melee weapons of the Tyranid are far more than bone and chitin.

quotes.name: Pollywog Symbiote
quotes.flavor: It always knew it was destined to be more than a frog.

quotes.name: Shanodin Dryads
quotes.flavor: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

quotes.name: Priest of Ancient Lore
quotes.flavor: "We are a product of our ancestors, the apotheosis of countless noble generations. Speak their names with reverence, and they will guide your path."

quotes.name: Giant Crab
quotes.flavor: During the giant crabs' mating season, Skyshroud nights are filled with the clatter of their skirmishes.

quotes.name: In the Trenches
quotes.flavor: The battlefield became so pockmarked with craters and trenches that casualties were regularly attributed to "fell in a hole."

quotes.name: Disruptor Wanderglyph
quotes.flavor: Wherever the spores begin to take hold, it crushes the ground to rubble.

quotes.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
quotes.flavor: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.

quotes.name: Tato Farmer
quotes.flavor: "Try one! They're disgusting!"

quotes.name: Umbilicus
quotes.flavor: It was the explorers' only tether to reality.

quotes.name: Flickerwisp
quotes.flavor: Its wings disturb more than air.

quotes.name: Vampire Scrivener
quotes.flavor: No one remains on her list for long.

quotes.name: Quasiduplicate
quotes.flavor: "My greatest creation—me!"

quotes.name: Aetherborn Marauder
quotes.flavor: "I don't know what that is or who it belongs to, but it's shiny and I want it."

quotes.name: Untimely Malfunction
quotes.flavor: "No! This worked perfectly in the lab!"

quotes.name: Deathknell Berserker
quotes.flavor:
"Sven felled the elf with an arrow through the chest, but moments later, the corpse rose with a sneer to fight again."
—*Longbeard Saga*

quotes.name: Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness
quotes.flavor: "Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?"

quotes.name: Evolutionary Leap
quotes.flavor: The essence of nature is change.

quotes.name: Hexplate Golem
quotes.flavor:
"Use everything. Iron, rust, scrap . . . even the ground must join our cause."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

quotes.name: Protector of the Crown
quotes.flavor: "I gladly offer my weapon and my life to the glory of my sovereign."

quotes.name: Dragon Fodder
quotes.flavor: Los trasgos viajan a los picos de sacrificio en parejas, de manera tal que si hay un superviviente pueda contar los detalles del fallecimiento del otro.

quotes.name: Lightning Talons
quotes.flavor:
"The victim was either clawed to death or struck by lightning. Possibly both."
—Pel Javya, Wojek investigator

quotes.name: Plague Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

quotes.name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
quotes.flavor:
"Some goblins are expendable. Some are impossible to get rid of. But he's both—at the same time!"
—Starke

quotes.name: Jerren, Corrupted Bishop // Ormendahl, the Corrupter
quotes.flavor: "Ah, Jerren. You've been such a faithful, useful insect."

quotes.name: Universal Automaton
quotes.flavor:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

quotes.name: Gray Harbor Merfolk
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Harbormasters tend to forget that security shouldn't stop at the surface.

quotes.name: The Ninth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "Fantastic!"

quotes.name: Clone
quotes.flavor: The shapeshifter mimics with a twin's esteem and a mirror's cruelty.

quotes.name: Formidable Speaker
quotes.flavor: Jean-Emmanuel Depraz, World Champion XXIX

quotes.name: Court of Grace
quotes.flavor: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Tower
quotes.flavor:
"A cursed silhouette to look upon. Even if the halls stand empty, its vile shadows blight the land. I shudder to think of the evils that it held."
—Koth

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: Farmers cut the trees and buried their dead. The dead rose up and killed the farmers. The trees grew back and strangled the dead.

quotes.name: Bloodshot Cyclops
quotes.flavor: After their first encounter, the goblins named him Chuck.

quotes.name: Ambassador Oak
quotes.flavor: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

quotes.name: Vampire Nighthawk
quotes.flavor: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

quotes.name: Firebolt
quotes.flavor: Reach out and torch someone.

quotes.name: Dragon Arch
quotes.flavor: In their hunger for the arch's power, mages often forget that it only makes dragons easier to summon. It doesn't make them easier to control.

quotes.name: Lady Zhurong, Warrior Queen
quotes.flavor:
"A man, and such a fool! I, a woman, will fight them for you."
—Lady Zhurong to her husband Meng Huo, before leading an army against the Shu

quotes.name: Smokebraider
quotes.flavor: "Be silent and listen to your inner fire. Only then can you walk the Path of Flame."

quotes.name: Burnout Bashtronaut
quotes.flavor: "Anybody looking for a torque dork?"

quotes.name: Illithid Harvester // Plant Tadpoles
quotes.flavor: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

quotes.name: Shield Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, order defeats chaos.

quotes.name: Aether Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Lightning Axe
quotes.flavor: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Martyr of Frost
quotes.flavor:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Crested Sunmare
quotes.flavor:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: High Tide
quotes.flavor:
"By the time their enemies noticed the sea's changing mood, the Vodalians had often shifted formation and were ready to attack."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

quotes.name: Daybreak Coronet
quotes.flavor:
"Let the deception of the gods yield to the pure light of day."
—Brimaz, king of Oreskos

quotes.name: Mnemonic Wall
quotes.flavor:
"I'd build an entire fortress of them if I could."
—Mzali, Lighthouse archmage

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Echo Storm
quotes.flavor: An organized and methodical reproduction.

quotes.name: True Polymorph
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Maybe a little *too* convincing.

quotes.name: Raze the Effigy
quotes.flavor: The folk of Kessig build up their courage by burning effigies of the things they fear.

quotes.name: Spined Wurm
quotes.flavor:
"As it moved, the wurm's spines gathered up bits of flowstone, which took the shapes of dead villagers' heads. Each head spoke a single sound, but if taken together, they said, 'Alas for the living.'"
—Dal myth of the wurm

quotes.name: Dark Fortress
quotes.flavor:
"You talk of freedoms. Liberty. Whose hands do you think built these battlements? In their hearts, peasants want to be ruled."
—Baron Zemo

quotes.name: Bruna, the Fading Light // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: She now sees only Emrakul's visions.

quotes.name: Deepchannel Mentor
quotes.flavor: The rivers can no longer provide safe passage for travelers and commerce. They serve only as highways for raiders and channels for blood and woe.

quotes.name: The Spike Cactus
quotes.flavor: TARGET

quotes.name: Gravedigger
quotes.flavor: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

quotes.name: Baloth Null
quotes.flavor:
"Humans use pigs to hunt for mushrooms, don't they? It's like that."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

quotes.name: Flora Colossus
quotes.flavor:
"You mean there was a *whole planet* of Groots out there?"
—Rocket Raccoon

quotes.name: Annex
quotes.flavor: Most refugees left their ancestral homes behind when they came to Otaria. A few decided to bring them along.

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Fighting Chance
quotes.flavor: A stroke of luck can smite an army.

quotes.name: Entourage of Trest
quotes.flavor:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

quotes.name: Magewright's Stone
quotes.flavor: The stones hark back to an age before civilization, when the living earth blessed all who trod its untamed wilds.

quotes.name: Repeal
quotes.flavor:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

quotes.name: Centaur Veteran
quotes.flavor: He wears his scars like badges of honor, warning his foes that he's not easily defeated.

quotes.name: Abaddon the Despoiler
quotes.flavor: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

quotes.name: Bolg, Erebor's Reckoning
quotes.flavor: His hatred for Dwarves smoldered for years after they killed his father Azog. When they killed the Great Goblin, the embers became a blaze.

quotes.name: Drownyard Explorers
quotes.flavor: "Angels and inquisitors terrorize villages, but no one seems to notice the stirring out at sea."

quotes.name: Wall of Dust
quotes.flavor: An ever-moving swarm of dust engulfs and disorients anything that comes near.

quotes.name: Deathleaper, Terror Weapon
quotes.flavor: Created to break will and bone with equal ferocity.

quotes.name: Manor Gate
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: A barrier that shields privileged eyes from the city's woes.

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes the hardest choice is between two wonders."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

quotes.name: Prodigious Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Look how cute it is now!"
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Cao Ren, Wei Commander
quotes.flavor: Cao Cao's cousin, Cao Ren was known throughout the three kingdoms as the fiercest of warriors.

quotes.name: Spectacular Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "Have no fear. Spidey is here!"

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

quotes.name: Meeting of Minds
quotes.flavor:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: Ancient Tomb
quotes.flavor:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

quotes.name: Afterthought Sentry
quotes.flavor: An eyeless guard of stone watches a forgotten annex of memory, granite feathers rustling in breezes no one thinks to remember.

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor: The squad plunged deep into Hive Pandorial, finding only the shambling corpses of those they came to avenge.

quotes.name: Death Speakers
quotes.flavor:
"The dead may be beyond the law, but speaking the wisdom of the dead will afford no protection!"
—Calmont, Aysen bureaucrat

quotes.name: Gyre Engineer
quotes.flavor: "As I contemplate what is, I dive ever deeper into the depths of possibility. Then I set an experiment in motion and watch the truth rise to the surface."

quotes.name: Twinflame Travelers
quotes.flavor:
"Look to the sky and you can still see them together, searching for their perfect home."
—*Two Starfalls and Other Tales*

quotes.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
quotes.flavor: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

quotes.name: Skyclave Relic
quotes.flavor: Skyclaves held the key to reshaping the world.

quotes.name: Arcbound Ravager
quotes.flavor:
"Top-performing automaton combatants are to be seized and modified for service."
—Confiscation directive

quotes.name: Aberrant Researcher // Perfected Form
quotes.flavor:
"Metamorphosis is a process."
—Laboratory notes

quotes.name: Feather of Flight
quotes.flavor: As he grasped the glowing feather, the lizard's heart soared, and the rest of him quickly followed.

quotes.name: Gorilla Berserkers
quotes.flavor:
"Beneath serenity may lie a hidden rage."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

quotes.name: Garenbrig Carver // Shield's Might
quotes.flavor: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

quotes.name: Rooftop Storm
quotes.flavor:
"Let those idiot priests tremble! A new era in unlife begins here and now. Oglor, raise the lightning vane!"
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Scared Stiff
quotes.flavor: The horrors of Sorin's Haunted Mansion scared Hurrk half to life.

quotes.name: Flood
quotes.flavor:
"A dash of cool water does wonders to clear a cluttered battlefield."
—Vibekke Ragnild, *Witches and War*

quotes.name: Zombie Apocalypse
quotes.flavor:
"Tantir-ah-mis-trobeen-ha-zar-ta
Tantir-man-ov-mis-hazen-sober.
Kanda. Kanda. Kanda."

quotes.name: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist
quotes.flavor: "They will call you a monster, but I call you worthy."

quotes.name: Drag to the Underworld
quotes.flavor: The more you struggle against death, the tighter its grip becomes.

quotes.name: Stonewood Invoker
quotes.flavor: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

quotes.name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, a pyromancer's spark ignited a fiery conflagration.

quotes.name: Mishra's Bauble
quotes.flavor:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

quotes.name: Summon Undead
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The air itself shuddered at the wizard's words, and from the dark beyond, her call was answered.

quotes.name: Gatecreeper Vine
quotes.flavor: Every inch of Ravnica is home to something.

quotes.name: My First Tome
quotes.flavor: This card is named My First Tome.

quotes.name: Thorn of the Black Rose
quotes.flavor: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of bureaucracy.

quotes.name: Blightcaster
quotes.flavor: "Your flesh is unprepared for my gifts."

quotes.name: Thragtusk
quotes.flavor:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

quotes.name: Jaws of Stone
quotes.flavor: When giants find their mountain homes infested, they have a whole range of solutions.

quotes.name: Ulvenwald Tracker
quotes.flavor: "Peace will come to Innistrad, but only after all abominations have been dealt with, one by one."

quotes.name: Sporemound
quotes.flavor:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

quotes.name: Tandem Tactics
quotes.flavor: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

quotes.name: Return to Nature
quotes.flavor:
"Long after the magic wore off, the mice still dreamed of glorious galloping."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Destined Confrontation
quotes.flavor:
"Just you and me, brother. The showdown that was always meant to be."
—Azula

quotes.name: Territorial Gorger
quotes.flavor: Inventors have been known to capture gremlins with the intent to release them in a rival's workshop. More often than not, that plan backfires.

quotes.name: Aven Squire
quotes.flavor: When the meek charge into battle, courage becomes infectious.

quotes.name: Tempered Steel
quotes.flavor:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

quotes.name: Firebolt
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: Reach out and torch someone.

quotes.name: Carnivorous Death-Parrot
quotes.flavor: Save a kill spell to deal with this guy.

quotes.name: Hour of Promise
quotes.flavor: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

quotes.name: Acquisition Octopus
quotes.flavor: You can never have too many arms.

quotes.name: Nightwing Shade
quotes.flavor:
"There is one hour of the night even we do not watch."
—Sedva, captain of the watch

quotes.name: Slayer of the Wicked
quotes.flavor: You don't want to see his trophy room.

quotes.name: Serpent's Gift
quotes.flavor: Venom is nature's way of redressing the imbalance between weak and mighty.

quotes.name: Reveille Squad
quotes.flavor: "To arms! To arms! The Lion roars!"

quotes.name: Macabre Waltz
quotes.flavor:
"All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy."
—Savra

quotes.name: Surgeon General Commander
quotes.flavor: Likes: augmentation, fluffy animals, creative templating.

quotes.name: Reclaim
quotes.flavor: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

quotes.name: Ark of Hunger
quotes.flavor: Few relics survived the turmoil of the Blood Age; those that did are powerful, dangerous, or both.

quotes.name: Timid Drake
quotes.flavor: It flees from anything that isn't shaped like a cloud.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"Our world is vast, but Thraben is its heart. The cathedral must stand even if the hinterlands are lost."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Elvish Ranger
quotes.flavor:
"How can any Human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

quotes.name: Macetail Hystrodon
quotes.flavor: The goblins tracked the hystrodon with much stealth and cunning. Then they were eaten with much pain and yelling.

quotes.name: Vulturous Zombie
quotes.flavor:
"When something dies, all things benefit. Well okay, just our things."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Accursed Spirit
quotes.flavor: Many have heard the slither of dragging armor and the soft squelch of its voice. But only its victims ever meet its icy gaze.

quotes.name: Invasion of Kaladesh // Aetherwing, Golden-Scale Flagship
quotes.flavor: Inspired by the grace of Ixalan's pterodons, Saheeli built one of her own.

quotes.name: Glacial Crevasses
quotes.flavor:
"We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled. I can't believe it was mere coincidence."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

quotes.name: Blessed Orator
quotes.flavor: His quiet words fade into the night's chill, yet they burn into his listeners' minds with all the power of a thousand suns.

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

quotes.name: For the Emperor!
quotes.flavor: They all took up the cry, the missionaries, the pilgrims, the sisters of the Orders Militant. The forces of Chaos melted before the fire of their faith.

quotes.name: Krovikan Sorcerer
quotes.flavor:
"These sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Bedevil
quotes.flavor:
"That's the thing about the Avengers and their heroics. So easy to predict. So easy to foil!"
—Grim Reaper, Eric Williams

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Slingbow Trap
quotes.flavor: The Tajuru elves devised ways to let the forest defend itself.

quotes.name: Ovalchase Dragster
quotes.flavor: It'll either crash or win the race. Possibly both.

quotes.name: Despoiler of Souls
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Rats and vultures devour. It desecrates.

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor:
"But I am going to Mordor," said Frodo.
"I know that well enough," said Sam. "Of course you are. And I'm coming with you."

quotes.name: Phosphorescent Feast
quotes.flavor:
"Mushroom Queen sits among her spores, Enjoying life and avoiding chores."
—Ibblian pixie ditty

quotes.name: Liliana's Devotee
quotes.flavor: Liliana inspires horror in many and fanatical admiration in a few.

quotes.name: Master's Guide-Mural // Master's Manufactory
quotes.flavor:
"The Fomori are a foul and distant memory, but their war machines taught us much about large-scale armorcraft."
—Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon

quotes.name: Volcanic Hammer
quotes.flavor: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

quotes.name: Army of the Damned
quotes.flavor: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

quotes.name: Fusion Elemental
quotes.flavor: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

quotes.name: Chandra Nalaar // Chandra Nalaar
quotes.flavor:
Signature Magic: Pyromancy
Color Alignment: Red
Plane of Origin: Kaladesh
First Planeswalk: Regatha
Height: 5'6"
Holds league record for most bats incinerated.

quotes.name: Ivory Tower
quotes.flavor: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

quotes.name: Rot Shambler
quotes.flavor:
"If I die, feed me to a shambler. At least that way I'll be doing some good."
—Ryza, Oran-Rief scout

quotes.name: Ember Gale
quotes.flavor:
"Terrible wind. It whipped sparks into our skin, then stoked them even hotter!"
—Bowen, Barrenton guardcaptain

quotes.name: Entrancing Melody
quotes.flavor: The stronger the will, the more bewitching the song.

quotes.name: Ferocious Tigorilla
quotes.flavor: From a certain perspective, it's an inspiring story of overcoming obstacles.

quotes.name: Weakness
quotes.flavor: "For strength to have any meaning, there must also be . . . you."

quotes.name: Prize Pig
quotes.flavor: The habit of building farmhouses and barns began among the inhabitants of the Marish down by the Brandywine.

quotes.name: Painful Truths
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

quotes.name: Goblin Turncoat
quotes.flavor: Modo was great at making friends . . . into shields.

quotes.name: Elite Archers
quotes.flavor: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

quotes.name: Scholar of the Ages
quotes.flavor: "I study the past to find hope for the future."

quotes.name: Wistful Selkie
quotes.flavor: Selkies call to a sea they never swam, in a tongue they never spoke, with a song they never learned.

quotes.name: Resuscitate
quotes.flavor:
"It is the art of convincing someone to live."
—Orim, Samite healer

quotes.name: Fiery Emancipation
quotes.flavor:
"One day the mountain's fire will rise up to burn away our chains and end this age of oppression."
—*The Molten Prophecy*

quotes.name: Retrofitted Transmogrant
quotes.flavor:
"Repair it again! I need reinforcements by tomorrow."
—Ashnod

quotes.name: Rugged Prairie
quotes.flavor: Hobs bury their kin far from home. They believe the dry, open ground keeps hags from stealing the bones and gwyllions from stealing the spirits.

quotes.name: Three Tree Mascot
quotes.flavor:
"Every paw and claw should be at the celebrations in Three Tree City! Even the float is smiling!"
—*Valley Gazetteer*, four-acorn review

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: During their endless travels, the mages of the Goma Fada caravan have learned ways to harness both life and death.

quotes.name: Raid Bombardment
quotes.flavor: Goblins in the first wave of a fire raid always bemoan the aim of everyone else.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Bone Flute
quotes.flavor: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

quotes.name: Pili-Pala
quotes.flavor: It wasn't really expected to fly. Then again, it wasn't expected to move, either.

quotes.name: Umbra Mystic
quotes.flavor: "I have found the courage to face death—twice, if I must."

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

quotes.name: Ravenous Rats
quotes.flavor: Devouring books is only the beginning. The librarian's next.

quotes.name: Lo and Li, Royal Advisors
quotes.flavor: "Azula, we are concerned for you and your well-being."

quotes.name: Savanti Romero, Time's Exile
quotes.flavor: "When I am done, there will be no evidence that you ever existed!"

quotes.name: Selfless Spirit
quotes.flavor: "There is always more to give."

quotes.name: Drossforge Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to ruin is forged in pain.

quotes.name: Grazing Whiptail
quotes.flavor: Often found browsing on the upper canopies of Ixalan's jungles, whiptails are known to absently bat away anything foolish enough to interrupt their meal.

quotes.name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah // Ajani, Nacatl Avenger
quotes.flavor: His pride denied him; his brother did not.

quotes.name: Stone Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"The spirit of the stone is the spirit of strength."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

quotes.name: Stern Lesson
quotes.flavor:
"The brothers are brilliant, but their quarreling will be the death of me."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Goblin General
quotes.flavor: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

quotes.name: Eater of Hope
quotes.flavor: Gods can be appeased. Demons, however . . .

quotes.name: Radha, Coalition Warlord
quotes.flavor:
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons."
—Grand Warlord Radha

quotes.name: War Falcon
quotes.flavor: The falcon is the picture of nobility, maintaining a regal bearing even as it conducts the bloody business of war.

quotes.name: Orochi Merge-Keeper
quotes.flavor: One day the spirit and mortal realms will be one. Until then, she faithfully guards the sites where they merge.

quotes.name: Angelheart Vial
quotes.flavor: It holds a whisper from Iona: "Persevere."

quotes.name: Shepherd of the Lost
quotes.flavor:
"Should you fall in the wilds, lift your voice to the Sky Realm. The one who answers will be your salvation."
—Emeria's Creed

quotes.name: Fishliver Oil
quotes.flavor: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

quotes.name: Rend Flesh
quotes.flavor:
"The Reito Massacre was a testament to the kami's unstoppable power. The human defenders might as well have been moths battling a forest fire."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Dimir Cluestone
quotes.flavor: It waits in the chill of the undercity, holding nameless secrets for those who dare to touch it.

quotes.name: Luminarch Aspirant
quotes.flavor: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

quotes.name: Sanctum Prelate
quotes.flavor: *Whispered Memories*, by Johannes Voss

quotes.name: Polluted Delta
quotes.flavor: A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"It's just playing with us, Marsden."
—Dafynne the Radiant, last words

quotes.name: Prickleboar
quotes.flavor:
"Canyons in the Phoberos badlands are essentially gates to the Underworld."
—Mirinthes, Akroan captain

quotes.name: Mindspring Merfolk
quotes.flavor: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths. Since then, they had fully integrated into Avishkari society.

quotes.name: Kindled Fury
quotes.flavor:
"It is most honorable to use every part of the animals we kill . . . especially if we use them to annihilate our enemies."
—Surrak, the Hunt Caller

quotes.name: Slag Fiend
quotes.flavor:
"Seal the furnace vents. Admit no others. We'll tend our forges without their tainted ways."
—Decree of Urabrask

quotes.name: Stitcher's Supplier
quotes.flavor: No part goes to waste.

quotes.name: Wing Snare
quotes.flavor:
"We are the hands of the great trees, reaching out to ensnare what threatens their branches."
—Elvish hunter

quotes.name: Target Minotaur
quotes.flavor: "Not again!"

quotes.name: Quantum Entanglement
quotes.flavor:
"Mar-Vell is part of me now. Like I am of him."
—Rick Jones

quotes.name: Venser, Shaper Savant
quotes.flavor: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

quotes.name: Groundswell
quotes.flavor: "This world will not be tamed."

quotes.name: Ragamuffyn
quotes.flavor: They cut the stitches and give her sips of her brew. Then they sew her up again, and she's back to stirring.

quotes.name: Thousand-Year Storm
quotes.flavor: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

quotes.name: Grim Lavamancer
quotes.set_name: Premium Deck Series: Fire and Lightning
quotes.flavor: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is the universal currency of the Multiverse. It is power. It is freedom. It is possibility itself."

quotes.name: Wayward Servant
quotes.flavor: If one of the anointed fails to serve with perfect obedience, the desert is always ready to receive it.

quotes.name: Éomer of the Riddermark
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: But northward the white crest of Éomer led the great front of the Rohirrim which he had again gathered and marshaled.

quotes.name: Oculus
quotes.flavor:
"In its gaze I saw no mercy, no recognition that I was worthy to exist."
—Kara Vrist, Neurok agent

quotes.name: Harbinger of the Seas
quotes.flavor: The rising moon calls mercilessly to the waves, commanding the sea to rise high enough to devour mountains.

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor: What wizards fear most is losing their minds.

quotes.name: Seed Spark
quotes.flavor:
"If you ask me, those root-lovers value mindless dogma over progress."
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

quotes.name: Midnight Reaper
quotes.flavor: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: Jaheira, Friend of the Forest
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "The Harpers' movement grows, but it needs sunlight to blossom. We can be that light."

quotes.name: Creeping Mold
quotes.flavor: Sanctions, mandates, regulations . . . These things mean nothing to the natural world.

quotes.name: Role Reversal
quotes.flavor: Uthlon the Wise scandalized sphinx society, hooting the answers to riddles as he rampaged through Tin Street. Grangle, on the other hand, sat for hours, deep in thought, largely ignored by fellow goblins.

quotes.name: Shimmering Grotto
quotes.flavor:
"This is the price of being last in the food chain. We must keep our places of beauty hidden away instead of displayed for all to see."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

quotes.name: Prowling Felidar
quotes.flavor: On occasion, felidars leave meaty "gifts" outside the tents of explorers they consider worthy.

quotes.name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
quotes.flavor: From the Roil emerged a ravenous primordial being of pure mana.

quotes.name: Strength in Numbers
quotes.flavor:
"The hermit dies. The outcast dies. The lone wolf dies. Only those who stick together survive this world."
—Uros, Pendelhaven elder

quotes.name: Golden Ratio
quotes.flavor:
"When I look around, I see a world defined by patterns that still manages to defy them."
—Kianne, Quandrix dean

quotes.name: Garruk's Packleader
quotes.flavor:
"He has learned much in his long years. And unlike selfish humans, he's willing to share."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Council's Judgment
quotes.flavor: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

quotes.name: Knollspine Dragon
quotes.flavor: It woke to find a vast world in need of a master.

quotes.name: Expedition Map
quotes.flavor:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Angel of Mercy
quotes.flavor: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

quotes.name: Silent Departure
quotes.flavor: The same magic that lets geists pass through our realm can force them out of it.

quotes.name: Bitterblossom
quotes.flavor: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Artifact construction required immense resources.

quotes.name: Ring of the Lucii
quotes.flavor:
"Kings of Lucis... come to me!"
—Noctis Lucis Caelum

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: Warrior's Charge
quotes.flavor: It is not the absence of fear that makes a warrior, but its domination.

quotes.name: Temple of Silence
quotes.flavor:
"We are a family of dreamers, a band of astral explorers, and a church of the mind."
—Jackson

quotes.name: Cabal Coffers
quotes.flavor:
"Evil things came forth, and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread; it is now called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery."
—Elrond

quotes.name: Preordain
quotes.flavor:
"Raw power wins battles, but those who choose the shape of the battlefield win the war."
—*The Pool of Knowledge*, opening inscription

quotes.name: Royal Trooper
quotes.flavor: "Loyalty guides me. Pride compels me. Anger sustains me. And the pay isn't bad."

quotes.name: Pyre-Sledge Arsonist
quotes.flavor: Everything from damaged furniture to inconvenient corpses becomes fuel for Ziatora's ever-burning foundry.

quotes.name: Tragic Lesson
quotes.flavor: Though Kefnet's followers feverishly searched his last words for some final riddle, they found only the gurgles of a dying god.

quotes.name: Firemind Vessel
quotes.flavor: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

quotes.name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
quotes.flavor: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

quotes.name: Bonecrusher Giant // Stomp
quotes.flavor: Not every tale ends in glory.

quotes.name: Night Market Lookout
quotes.flavor: The Consulate rarely cracks the coded announcement of a night market's location before dawn, and enforcers are taken care of if they wander too close.

quotes.name: Raging Regisaur
quotes.flavor: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

quotes.name: Tireless Provisioner
quotes.flavor: "*Lembas* is more strengthening than any food made by Men."

quotes.name: Dualcaster Mage
quotes.flavor: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: No spot in nature is truly barren.

quotes.name: Youthful Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: Before she is admitted to the host of Starnheim, a young valkyrie must learn a thousand tales of her ancestors.

quotes.name: Jade Statue
quotes.flavor: "Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock." —Norin the Wary

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Used carefully, material that has been exposed to the baleful energies of the Warp can be contained to fuel powerful rituals.

quotes.name: Ethercaste Knight
quotes.flavor: "We coat ourselves in steel every day. What is etherium but the next logical step?"

quotes.name: Threads of Disloyalty
quotes.flavor: "Every thought is a string. You just have to find the right ones to pull."

quotes.name: Simian Spirit Guide
quotes.flavor: First, an explosion of fire on the ground. Then, an explosion of laughter in the trees.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Taxi Driver
quotes.flavor: "I got two speeds, buddy: fast and off duty."

quotes.name: Reshape
quotes.flavor:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

quotes.name: Foxfire Oak
quotes.flavor:
"The brethren shall blaze with unnatural fire, and the flame shall consume and purify our rage."
—Treefolk catastrophe myth

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor:
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers."
—Jazal Goldmane

quotes.name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
quotes.flavor: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

quotes.name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
quotes.flavor: Savage, loyal, and utterly relentless in service to evil.

quotes.name: Dread Presence
quotes.flavor: It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.

quotes.name: Brash Taunter
quotes.flavor: "Why don't you come a little closer and say that again, you spineless spit-licker!"

quotes.name: Dusk Legion Dreadnought
quotes.flavor: It loomed up over the horizon, silent and dark as a grave.

quotes.name: Fortune Teller
quotes.flavor: TODAY'S FORTUNE: ON YOUR DEATHBED, YOU WILL REGRET NOT EATING MORE PIZZA. (This fortune brought to you by our sponsor Saheeli Pie Pizzeria, located on the boardwalk next to Teferi's Time Twister. Bring this fortune to get 15% off any purchase.)

quotes.name: Challenger Troll
quotes.flavor: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

quotes.name: Tinybones, Trinket Thief
quotes.flavor: Big distractions mean tiny nuisances can slip by unnoticed.

quotes.name: Silverquill Campus
quotes.flavor: Mage-students drawn to the power of language choose Silverquill, the college of eloquence.

quotes.name: Overbeing of Myth
quotes.flavor:
"She walks among us unseen, learning from our imperfections."
—*The Seer's Parables*

quotes.name: Sea Monster
quotes.flavor: Water is life. Or perhaps it is just something to wash it down with.

quotes.name: Traverse the Outlands
quotes.flavor: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

quotes.name: Baleful Stare
quotes.flavor: "Though there is little to be learned from your dust and stones, I shall wring them dry nevertheless."

quotes.name: Ruhan of the Fomori
quotes.flavor: Unfettered by allegiance, driven by war.

quotes.name: Thalakos Seer
quotes.flavor:
"You see our world when you shut your eyes so tightly that tiny shapes float before them."
—Lyna, to Ertai

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

quotes.name: Patrol Signaler
quotes.flavor: Many a keen-eared bogle has run afoul of a clever and silently orchestrated kithkin ambush.

quotes.name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
quotes.flavor: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

quotes.name: Moment of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: The archaics experience all of Arcavian history. Changing that fate threatens their very existence.

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor: Sent to find Sorin, Jace ventured to the vampire's ancestral home, only to find evidence of a deeper mystery.

quotes.name: Wind Spirit
quotes.flavor:
" . . . When the trees bow down their heads, The wind is passing by."
—Christina Rossetti,
"Who Has Seen the Wind?"

quotes.name: Buried Alive
quotes.flavor: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

quotes.name: Wall of Omens
quotes.flavor:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

quotes.name: Snakeskin Veil
quotes.flavor: "Does a serpent roar and chase its prey? No. A serpent waits silently for oblivious prey to draw near."

quotes.name: Bred for the Hunt
quotes.flavor:
"Looks like we've found the source. Torch it quick, before anything crawls out."
—Sergeant "Ripper" Jackson

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: The Eldrazi may be ruthless, but Zendikar is relentless.

quotes.name: Anticognition
quotes.flavor:
"I think not."
—Flekon the Mindcensor

quotes.name: Adarkar Sentinel
quotes.flavor:
"We encountered the Sentinels in the wastes, near no living thing. Their purpose was inscrutable."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Urza's Factory
quotes.flavor:
"Though their ideals are leagues apart, Urza's and Mishra's creations have a surprising harmony with one another."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Grim Contest
quotes.flavor: The invader hoped he could survive the beast's jaws and emerge through its rotting skin.

quotes.name: Legion Extruder
quotes.flavor: When the vault door opened, ancient war machines rumbled to life.

quotes.name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: All are welcome.

quotes.name: Deathbloom Thallid
quotes.flavor:
"Nature is not always gentle or kind, but all life begets life."
—Marwyn of Llanowar

quotes.name: Bloodmark Mentor
quotes.flavor: Boggarts divide the world into two categories: things you can eat, and things you have to chase down and pummel before you can eat.

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Consider
quotes.flavor: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

quotes.name: Vela the Night-Clad
quotes.flavor: Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.

quotes.name: Graven Lore
quotes.flavor: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.

quotes.name: War Mammoth
quotes.flavor: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

quotes.name: Monica Rambeau // Photon, Living Light
quotes.flavor: Above the city, she glows . . .

quotes.name: Spire Mangler
quotes.flavor: Its mandibles can leave a rider in the clouds astride a headless griffin.

quotes.name: Heartless Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"They won't be winning any beauty pageants, but they'll do the trick."
—Enslow, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

quotes.name: Information Booth
quotes.flavor: "Sir, this may be the information booth, but I cannot answer ontological questions. It would be arrogant to assume I could describe the true nature of reality. Also there's a line."

quotes.name: Foul Imp
quotes.flavor: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

quotes.name: Transmutation
quotes.flavor: "You know what I was,/ You see what I am: change me, change me!" —Randall

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

quotes.name: Katara, Waterbending Master
quotes.flavor: "The strength of your heart makes you who you are."

quotes.name: Tomik, Distinguished Advokist
quotes.flavor: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Snatcher! Protect the children!

quotes.name: Cagemail
quotes.flavor:
"Power often costs too high a price."
—Commander Eesha

quotes.name: Sultai Skullkeeper
quotes.flavor: A skullkeeper is the first to arrive after the palace archers strike down intruders, probing their brains for choice bits of knowledge.

quotes.name: Reanimate
quotes.flavor:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Mutiny
quotes.flavor: Pirate captains rarely enjoy a peaceful retirement.

quotes.name: Sanctum of Calm Waters
quotes.flavor:
Truth lurks in the depths,
Invisible from the shore.
Knowledge inundates.

quotes.name: Death Grasp
quotes.flavor: Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.

quotes.name: Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky
quotes.flavor: Angry ghosts poured through and pummeled the Invasion Tree, filling the heavens with the rhythms of war.

quotes.name: Armored Transport
quotes.flavor:
"If only our jails were as secure."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Jareth, Leonine Titan
quotes.flavor: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

quotes.name: Zendikar Incarnate
quotes.flavor:
"Her people angered Zendikar, and they faced the land's wrath. That is why Nissa is the last of the animists."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

quotes.name: Consume Spirit
quotes.flavor: Mephidross changes all who dwell there, taking their lives and adding them to its own.

quotes.name: Boil
quotes.flavor:
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
quotes.flavor: "Life is as fleeting as it is vibrant. Embrace the brief blessing of a flower before it withers."

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Screeching Harpy
quotes.flavor:
"They are called 'fowl' for a reason."
—Mirri of the Weatherlight

quotes.name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound
quotes.flavor: There are not enough lives on Innistrad to satisfy his thirst for retribution.

quotes.name: Infiltration Lens
quotes.flavor: Neurok spies carry devices that let them look a few moments into the future, giving them an almost insurmountable edge.

quotes.name: Spitfire Lagac
quotes.flavor:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Tsabo Tavoc
quotes.flavor: "I might almost pity my enemies—if it wasn't so amusing to watch them die."

quotes.name: Unnatural Growth
quotes.flavor: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

quotes.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
quotes.flavor:
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense."
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

quotes.name: Planar Guide
quotes.flavor: "Every moment has its own savior."

quotes.name: Pain Magnification
quotes.flavor: The Rakdos make sure their victims remember their pain—or at least give up a little bit of their sanity in order to forget.

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: "Catch!"

quotes.name: On Wings of Gold
quotes.flavor: The edge of Naktamun was once protected by Kefnet. The honored mummies who patrol it now do so in his image.

quotes.name: Chill
quotes.flavor:
"Temper, temper."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Soulstone Sanctuary
quotes.flavor: Explorers mistakenly focused on the hands, not what they could be grasping towards.

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

quotes.name: Hostile Takeover
quotes.flavor: Ob Nixilis smiled. It had been over one thousand years since his last conquest.

quotes.name: Lightning Axe
quotes.flavor: Spirits disturbed by ghoulcallers become geists driven by restless anger.

quotes.name: Scarecrow Guide
quotes.flavor:
"You're doing a splendid job, my noble stitched friend. Not a single bird has attacked us!"
—Troyan

quotes.name: Eron the Relentless
quotes.flavor:
"Eron would be much less of a hassle if only he were mortal."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

quotes.name: Phantom Monster
quotes.flavor:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

quotes.name: Impulse
quotes.flavor:
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Seal of Removal
quotes.flavor:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

quotes.name: High-Society Hunter
quotes.flavor: She preys on Thraben's elites, known for their sophisticated taste.

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Zodiac Goat
quotes.flavor: ". . . Near death in Baidi, having reigned three years, / Bei sadly placed his son in Kongming's care. . . ."

quotes.name: Wildfire
quotes.flavor: Fire is always at the top of the food chain, and it has a *big* appetite.

quotes.name: Paralyzing Grasp
quotes.flavor:
"Obviously, the Firemind's mission is worth more than a few goblins."
—Pelener, chamberlain of Niv-Mizzet

quotes.name: Maximus, Knight Apparent
quotes.flavor: "It is a knight's duty to better this fallen world."

quotes.name: Hungry Spriggan
quotes.flavor: If a spriggan's eyes are larger than its stomach, it has ways to remedy the situation.

quotes.name: Reconnaissance Mission
quotes.flavor:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Act on Impulse
quotes.flavor: "You don't want to know what happens after I put on the goggles."

quotes.name: Sword Dancer
quotes.flavor: Most soldiers think of the sword as a weapon. In the hands of Zho monks, swords are also the strongest of shields.

quotes.name: Seal of the Guildpact
quotes.flavor:
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Lurking Deadeye
quotes.flavor: "There's no roar so mighty that it can't be silenced."

quotes.name: Unstable Obelisk
quotes.flavor: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

quotes.name: Ethereal Armor
quotes.flavor: Clad in the light of conviction and hope, Linette strode forth to face Duskmourn's terrors without fear.

quotes.name: Megrim
quotes.flavor: "You can run from your pain," explained Gerrard to Crovax, "but take it from experience: you will tire before it does."

quotes.name: Icatian Priest
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Grelden knelt and felt the cool, dry hand of the priest on his brow. Hours later, when his wits returned, he was covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.

quotes.name: Dryad Militant
quotes.flavor: "We will defend the Worldsoul from Izzet 'progress' at any cost."

quotes.name: Wildfire Emissary
quotes.flavor:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Reduce to Dreams
quotes.flavor:
"This world is a dream. We cling to our toys like children, but sooner or later we must learn to live without them."
—Sensei Hisoka

quotes.name: Savage Lands
quotes.flavor: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

quotes.name: Divination
quotes.flavor:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

quotes.name: Molten Duplication
quotes.flavor: No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.

quotes.name: Goblin Grenade
quotes.flavor:
"According to accepted theory, the grenade held some kind of flammable mixture and was carried to its target by a hapless goblin."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Fey Steed
quotes.flavor: Ride into legend.

quotes.name: Armory Guard
quotes.flavor: The Dimir agents watched from the shadows. "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed. "I suggest we find another way in."

quotes.name: Gustcloak Skirmisher
quotes.flavor: They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: A new civilization was built from the scrap of the old one.

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"It bends the light somehow, rendering it—and its wearer—functionally invisible. I never would have found it if I hadn't tripped over it!"
—Quintorius Kand, research notes

quotes.name: Retether
quotes.flavor: The rifts reach into infinite time streams, bringing the divergent products of alternate pasts into the present.

quotes.name: Ancient Grudge
quotes.flavor: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

quotes.name: Capture of Jingzhou
quotes.flavor: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

quotes.name: Stone Idol Generator
quotes.flavor:
"Like my people's ambitions, it is both awe-inspiring and unfinished."
—Nahiri

quotes.name: Inexorable Tide
quotes.flavor: Radiation is an invisible tide that seeps into the bones of the land, changing it irrevocably.

quotes.name: Homeward Path
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heels point you home."
—Ancient blessing

quotes.name: Spellseeker
quotes.flavor: Mages and warriors recruited from across Kylem display their skills at Valor's Reach.

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: War Mammoth
quotes.flavor: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

quotes.name: Alania, Divergent Storm
quotes.flavor: "Why would I chase the storm? Does a cloud chase the rain? Does the sun chase the light?"

quotes.name: Teysa Karlov
quotes.flavor: "Life and death are two sides of the same coin."

quotes.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
quotes.flavor:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Suppression Ray // Orderly Plaza
quotes.flavor: The Consulate's aether spotlights have a setting to incapacitate trespassers on contact.

quotes.name: Wonder
quotes.flavor:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: The Mechanist, Aerial Artisan
quotes.flavor: "We're just in the process of improving upon what's already here."

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

quotes.name: Moat
quotes.flavor: The purpose of any moat is to impede attack. Some are filled with water, some with thistles. Some are filled with things best left unseen.

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Talisman of Creativity
quotes.flavor:
"It is my cry that wakes you in the night, and my body that crouches in the shadow. I am Tzeentch and you are the puppet that dances to my tune."
—*The Book of Tzeentch*

quotes.name: Thrun, the Last Troll
quotes.flavor: His crime was silence, and now he suffers it eternally.

quotes.name: Sorcerer's Strongbox
quotes.flavor: Simun the Quiet filled the chest with his most precious thoughts. But in a fit of paranoia, he locked up the memory of where he hid the key.

quotes.name: Zetalpa, Primal Dawn
quotes.flavor: The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Engulfing Slagwurm
quotes.flavor: Its teeth exist only for decoration.

quotes.name: Vodalian Zombie
quotes.flavor:
"Every last one of you will become my servant. It's a shame you won't live to see the irony."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

quotes.name: Chrome Prowler
quotes.flavor: It can catch a rat and perform a spinal tap with one graceful swipe of its paw.

quotes.name: Magus of the Candelabra
quotes.flavor:
"What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"
—Teferi, to Jhoira

quotes.name: Archon of Emeria
quotes.flavor:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Disperse
quotes.flavor: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

quotes.name: Hungry Mist
quotes.flavor:
"All things must eat, after all. Even the air can hunger."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

quotes.name: Cogwork Assembler
quotes.flavor: Duplication is neither thievery nor flattery. It is efficiency.

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
quotes.flavor: "Greet death with sword in hand."
